Along the middle of the east coast of the US. Adults are usually attracted by dead or decaying wood,
where they like to lay their eggs, or by tree and plant sap.
howToCombat: We do not treat for Stag Beetles.

name: Stink Bugs
description:
What are they: Stink bugs are large, oval, or shield-shaped insects that produce a strong odor from their abdomen. Many
species of Stink bugs feed on plants. Some Stink bugs become serious pests of crops. When they attack fruits, like
peaches, they make the fruit unfit for sale.
whereLocated: Across the US.
howToCombat:
TruBarrier Perimeter Pest will help control Stink bugs; however, we do not treat for them inside the home
or above the first level of a home.

name: “Sugar” Ants
description:
What are they: Any ant variety that nests outdoors but comes into your home to feed on sweets and potentially nest.
"Sugar Ant" can refer to: Acrobat, Cornfield, False Honey, Little Black, Rover, Argentine, Carpenter, House, Pavement, and
Pharoah Ants.
whereLocated: Across the US, more of a problem in warmer states.
howToCombat:
Our Flea & Tick Control and TruBarrier Perimeter Pest Control will assist with most ant varieties. Customer
can also make sure food items are sealed and counters cleaned of residue. We do NOT treat Carpenter Ants or Pharoah
Ants in any program.

name: Termites
description:
What are they: Subterranean termites build their colonies in the soil and construct pathways in the ground to locate
sources of wood that remain below ground or on the ground surface.
whereLocated: Across the US and especially in warmer states.
howToCombat:
We do not treat Termites. If customer believes they have Termites, they should speak to a licensed
professional.

name: Thatching Ants
description:
What are they: Thatching ants are sometimes referred to as mound ants because some species construct mounds from
small sticks, grass stems, leaves, and pine or fir needles. They may also nest in decayed logs. Under most circumstances,
thatching ants should be considered beneficial, since they are fierce predators of other insects.
whereLocated: Thatching Ants are located across much of the western North America.
howToCombat: Our Flea & Tick Control will control tick populations by treating for these pests at the source.

name: Ticks
description:
What are they: Ticks are related to spiders and have eight legs. They feed on the blood of all kinds of animals, from birds
to deer to humans. Ticks can transmit Lyme disease and Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever.
whereLocated:
Across the US. Often found near wooded and highly vegetated areas. Some species require moisture to
survive.
howToCombat: Our Flea & Tick Control service will treat the areas around a home that will most likely harbor ticks.

name: Wasps
description:
What are they: A wasp is any member of a group of insects in the order Hymenoptera, suborder Apocrita, some of which
are stinging. Wasps are distinguished from the ants and bees of Apocrita by various behavioral and physical characteristics,
particularly their possession of a slender, smooth body and legs with relatively few hairs.
howToCombat:
We do not treat for wasps. TruGreen’s Perimeter Pest Control will remove inactive nests under eaves up
to 10 feet above the foundation.

name: Yellowjackets
description:
See Wasps
Glossary of Terms

name: Aeration
description:
Mechanical process that removes cores of soil from the ground. Removed cores are left on top of the lawn, dissolving
over time back into the lawn. In markets with very sandy soils, the cores may break apart immediately.
•
One of the best things you can do for your lawn besides watering
•
Enhances root development and water circulation
•
Allows better treatment and nutrient penetration
•
Reduces soil compaction and helps manage thatch layer
Depending on the region, we may follow an aeration service with overseeding.

name: Agronomics
description: Study of plants and soil as related to crop production (in TruGreen’s case, turfgrasses).

name: Application
description: Refers to a TruGreen treatment. Do not use “treatment” to describe an application or service. Do not use the term “app.”

name: Audit
description:
A sales audit is a standard checkpoint to ensure a customer has a clear understanding of what they are buying and what to expect. There are 3 different ways a
customer can confirm services purchased – Email, text or via live auditor.

name: Bad Debt
description:
When TruGreen is not at fault and the customer refuses to pay. These accounts are coded as bad debt write-offs. Bad Debts are usually turned over to a collection
agency.
Bad debt customers cannot be reinstated or sold new programs until balance owed is paid in full.

name: Branch
description: Branches are a separate but dependent part of TruGreen from which services are fulfilled. TruGreen’s services are provided by over 250 local branches.

name: Calcium
description:
Calcium is an essential plant nutrient in soil. It is crucial because it helps the plant form new cell walls and grow new shoots and leaves. It also helps make plants
less susceptible to diseases and pest damage.

name: CFR
description: Customer Follow-up Request – a process for notifying the branch regarding service issues.

name: Commercial Customers
description:
Commercial customers are non-residential accounts (e.g., businesses, religious institutions, schools, etc.).
Commercial accounts are handled by local branches.

name: Cool Season Grasses
description:
Cool season grasses are a variety of grass species that thrive best in cooler temperatures and particularly in the cooler regions of the country from the central
transition zone throughout the northern U.S.
Cool season turfgrasses include bluegrasses, fescues, and ryegrasses.

name: Desertscape / TruScape
description:
Desertscape or TruScape is a service that targets weed in landscape grounds devoted to rock, gravel, or mulch surfaces.
Many TruGreen customers and homeowners in hot, dry locations use Desertscape to save water. Numerous counties and
cities require the use of Desertscape designs for new construction. Drought conditions in the southwest accelerate the
conversion of traditional landscapes to Desertscape. TruScape gives customers the option to treat for weeds in areas that
are not covered by TruGreen Lawn and TruShrub services.
Sales of this program are limited to the branch (property visit) so they can confirm the property is a Desertscape landscape
as this services will damage a lawn if improperly sold.

name: Dormant Oil
description:
Dormant oils work by suffocating present insect pests. Beneficial insects that encounter the oil later are not harmed. This can be done in the late winter or late fall.
Not all plants are suitable for this treatment. The specialist will determine which plans will get the most benefit. Also known as Horticultural oil.

name: EasyPay
description:
EasyPay is TruGreen’s free electronic payment service whereby customers’ payments are automatically charged to a credit card or deducted from a checking
account.
The customer’s credit card/bank account is charged immediately after the service is posted to their TruGreen account.
Customers do not have the option of selecting the date that payments are withdrawn from their account.

name: EcoCare Lawn Plan
description:
EcoCare Lawn Plan offers homeowners a greener approach to a greener lawn by combining ingredients with TruGreen expertise at a price homeowners
can feel good about. EcoCare Lawn Plan offers 5-6 applications a year dependent on location (every 35-45 days). This lawn plan includes:
• 5-6 services per year, dependent on location
o Specialist will visit every 35-45 days
• Nutrients are a unique blend of composted materials, micro-nutrients and extended-release fertilizers to provide steady, balanced nutrition
throughout the year
• Addition of organic bio-stimulants such as kelp improve soil health and tolerance to environmental stressors such as drought
• TruGreen's proven weed control treatments help prevent and treat weeds throughout the year
• Satisfaction Guarantee: TruGreen will gladly visit your property as needed between scheduled visits to ensure your satisfaction

name: Expanded Service
description:
Expanded services are beneficial services not included in the standard service programs and are available at additional cost.
Examples are Core Aeration, Fire Ant Control, TruDefense Mosquito Control and Soil Enhancers (e.g., Lime).

name: Fertilizer
description:
Any material of natural or synthetic origin that is applied to soil or to plant tissues to supply plant nutrients.
Promotes shoot, leaf, and root growth, density, color, and overall health.

name: Flea & Tick Control/Outdoor Nuisance Pest Control
description:
Our Flea & Tick Control program is designed to significantly reduce the number of active pests on our customers’ property. This service helps to control fleas,
ticks, chiggers, earwigs, and spiders. Our Flea & Tick Control Program can help reduce exposure to pests and pest-associated diseases. The Flea & Tick Control
plan consists of between 6 and 12 applications depending on the branch.

name: Full Program
description: Full Program customers receive 4 or more regionally tailored service visits for lawn, tree/shrub care, TruDefense or TruBarrier Perimeter Pest Control.

name: Fungicide
description:
A fungicide is a product used to help prevent a fungus from spreading throughout the lawn. Most lawn diseases cause little to no turf damage but may be visibly
unappealing. Damage caused by disease will grow out in time. Customer concerns should be inspected by specialist.

name: Hort
description:
“Hort” (short version of “Horticulture”), is a term we use when referring to Tree & Shrub programs (see “Tree/Shrub Programs” for explanation). The term Hort
should not be used when talking to a customer. It is an internal TruGreen term.

name: Insect and Disease Control
description:
The goal is to reduce the effects of disease, insect and mite population before tree plant damage occurs. These applications are applied when disease and insects
are present in the late spring, summer, and early fall.

name: Invoice
description:
An invoice is a bill for completed services that customers receive in the mail after each service.
This payment method is also referred to as “Pay by Invoice” or “PBI.”

name: Lime
description: Granular limestone is applied to help increase soil pH. Lime helps counteract acid soils. Creates a more suitable soil for healthy turf growth.

name: Nitrogen
description:
Nitrogen is included in some of our fertilizer treatments and helps to improve overall plant health, color, and promotes growth. It may not be applied with every
lawn application.

name: Overseeding
description:
Spreading new grass seed over existing turf. Overseeding restores bare spots, thinning turf, or patchy grass, and is a great way to improve the density of your
lawn and enhance its color. Overseeding with TruGreen incorporates advanced, high-quality seeds which have shown improved disease and drought tolerance in
university trials.
Overseeding is performed on cool season grasses – Fescue, Bluegrass, and Rye.
After an aeration with overseeding, customer should mow as usual until germination begins, then wait 10 days for seeds to establish before resuming mowing with
mower set at the highest setting.

name: PCI
description:
Acronym for “Payment Card Industry.” A series of standards that TruGreen follows regarding protecting customers’ personal information. Also referred to as “PCI
Compliant.”

name: Post-emergent
description:
Post-emergent weed control eliminates weeds that pop up throughout the year and keeps them from spreading. It is designed to eliminate weeds that are already
in the lawn. Also knows as targeted weed control.

name: Potassium (Potash)
description:
Is a nutrient that helps strengthen plants to fight against diseases. Helps plants survive drought and extreme temperatures. Creates a more suitable soil for healthy
turf growth.

name: Pre-emergent
description:
Pre-emergent weed control is used to prevent an undesired weed problem before it starts. This is achieved by applying a protective layer of pre-emergent herbicide
to the lawn, preventing the weeds from penetrating the soil barrier.

name: PrePay
description:
The PrePay plan allows our customers to pay for their entire service on an annual basis. TruGreen currently offers a discount to customers who choose to pay a
year in advance. It is important to note that some services may be excluded from PrePay discounts.

name: Property Visit
description:
A property visit is any time a branch representative visits the prospects home before purchasing a program. Property visits are warranted for these scenarios:
•
Prospect request (only after letting the customer know we can view their property, the benefits of setting up services over the phone and attempting to
overcome)
•
Property cannot be accurately measured
•
Service customer is requesting is not available in TruView or cannot be sold by the contact center sales representative

name: Residential Customers
description:
Residential customers are homeowners, renters, and landlords of non-commercial properties. This is our largest customer group. These accounts are handled by
the national sales team, including contact centers.

name: Revive
description:
Soil conditioner that contains organic fertilizer, iron, and surfactant. It helps improve water penetration to grass roots. Can help lawns come back from drought
stress.
Revive works great for challenging areas in the lawn including slopes, dry spots, and highly compacted areas. Maximizes water usage, reducing the overall amount
of water needed to achieve best results. Not all branches sell Revive.

name: Service Call
description:
TruGreen offers full program customers free service calls if they are not satisfied with the results of their service. During a service call, a specialist will return to
the customer’s residence, evaluate the property, and re-treat the problem area IF necessary.

name: Service Summary
description:
A Service Summary is a document that is created at the end of every application. This may be left at the door or transmitted electronically. The Service Summary
includes customer information, details of the treatment and recommendations from the specialist.

name: Specialist
description: Person that delivers applications to customers. Do not use “technician.”

name: Sulfur
description: Granular soil amendment that is used to help decrease soil pH. Creates a more suitable soil for healthy turf growth.

name: TruBarrier Perimeter Pest Control
description:
TruGreen’s TruBarrier Perimeter Pest Control is the best way for our customers and prospects to help prevent pests such as spiders, ants, cockroaches, and
earwigs from making their way into their home. TruBarrier Perimeter Pest Control targets pest populations where they live around the structure of our customers’
homes. The program prevents pests from entering homes, helping customers enjoy their indoor living spaces.
Our TruBarrier Perimeter Pest Control covers the following pests where they live and in areas where they could enter the customers’ homes:
•
Boxelder Bugs
•
Stink Bugs
•
Spiders
•
Earwigs
•
Millipedes
•
Centipedes
•
Paper Wasps
•
•
Cockroaches
•
Ants (except Fire Ants and Pharaoh Ants)

name: TruBasic
description:
TruBasic is our started weed and feed option. The TruBasic plan offers essential fertilizer and weed control for a
partial season, ensuring your lawn gets the right care when it matters most. Our team of trained and certified
professionals applies nutrient-packed treatments during the optimal times of the year. To tackle persistent weeds,
we rely on scientifically formulated products that not only treat existing weeds but also prevent future growth.
TruBasic does NOT offer the TruGreen Guarantee.
The TruView shopping cart will display the exact services provided for the customer’s region.

name: TruCore/TruHealth
description:
TruCore is our mid-grade option. It includes the same services as TruPro, except for aeration. It’s important to note that all lawns benefit from aeration. TruPro
offers the best results.
•

name: Trudy/Truman
description:
Trudy/Truman is TruGreen’s call ahead system that notifies the customer prior to a service visit.
•
Trudy calls one business day prior to the service for all services except aeration.
•
Truman calls for aerations three business days prior to the service.

name: TruGreen Guarantee
description:
Our guarantee states that “TruGreen will gladly visit your property as needed between scheduled visits to ensure your satisfaction”. The TruBasic and TruYou Partial
plans are not covered by the TruGreen Guarantee.

name: TruNatural
description:
TruNatural is our 100% natural organic fertilizer option. We offer this approach to meet the needs of customers who prefer a natural alternative.
TruNatural encourages healthy grass growth and gradually thickens the lawn
Does not include weed or insect control.
At the customer’s request, we will come out and treat for weeds using conventional products at no extra charge
Fertilizer nutrients in the TruNatural program come from animal components such as bone meal, feather meal and blood meal.

name: Warm Season Grasses
description:
Warm season grasses are a variety of grass species that thrive best in warmer temperatures between 80 and 95 degrees. Their primary range of adaptation is in
the southern and western regions of the country and the area known as the transition zone.
Warm season turfgrasses include Bermuda, St. Augustine, Bahia, Zoysia, and Centipede.
